prayer.heading: Prayer hour
prayer.order: Welcome → a moderator's opening prayer, if one is prepared → the collection: the songs, then prayer music → the requests are read out word for word, Open Doors' request of the day first, and appear on the wall as they are read → the host opens the prayer time → listeners' prayers: written ones read out word for word, spoken ones played, silence in between, a word of encouragement after the quiet minutes → outro. The host never prays. Requests sent while the presentation is being prepared (its last 7 minutes) are read in the prayer time.
prayer.onlyPrayer: A prayer hour takes prayer requests (typed or recorded) and, in its prayer time, listeners' own prayers (written or spoken).
prayer.intakeHint: In a prayer hour, these minutes count to the outro.
prayer.noMusic: Upload background music in Library first.
prayer.quietMin: Quiet minutes before the host encourages listeners again
prayer.notFallback: A prayer hour cannot be a channel's fallback program: its running order needs an end.
prayer.opendoors: Read Open Doors' daily prayer request for persecuted Christians first (German as published, translated for English listeners)

preaching.heading: Preaching program
preaching.order: Intro → a preaching → songs → the next preaching, if one still fits into the program → … → outro. Listeners' suggestions come first, then the library's preachings, each in turn; none plays twice within six hours. When no preaching fits any more, songs play to the end.
preaching.intakeHint: A suggested preaching fills the queue with its whole length: for a long program, raise “Close when the queue holds … minutes”. One that no longer fits before the end stays in the library for a later preaching program.

opening.heading: Opening prayers
opening.hint: Each airing takes the oldest one waiting; without one, the hour has no opening prayer (the AI host never prays). A typed prayer is read word for word in the host voice, only in the languages you fill in; a recording plays as it is (at most 3 minutes). The opening is planned about 8 minutes before the hour: a prayer added later serves the next airing.
opening.none: None prepared — the hour opens without an opening prayer.

account.title: Delete account
account.hint: Deletes your account on our server and everything you sent us, then this device’s data.
account.goesIdentity: your account: name, country and your passphrase, on every device that uses it
account.goesSubmissions: everything you sent: song requests and suggestions, recordings (also those kept for repeats), prayer requests — off the prayer wall and out of the program, if they have not aired yet
account.goesVoices: your community voices and the reports about your messages
account.goesDevice: Arche Radio’s data on this device
account.stays: Kept for a while, then deleted as well:
account.staysText: what already went out in the program’s published files (up to 48 hours), our backups (up to 7 days), reports you filed (without your name, up to 30 days) and the security log (up to 90 days). Requested songs may stay in the music selection, without your name or dedication.
account.staff: You also lose your moderator role. The last administrator cannot delete their account.

page.title: Delete your Arche Radio account
page.intro: You can delete your Arche Radio account and everything you sent us at any time — in the app (Profile › Delete account) or here.
page.here: This browser uses an account on our server. Delete it, with everything sent from it:
page.hereNone: This browser has no account on our server.
page.words: Do you use a passphrase? Enter its 12 words to delete that account from here — for example when you no longer have the app.
page.neitherTitle: Without the app and without your words
page.neither: Then we cannot tell which data is yours. A device without a passphrase is deleted automatically 60 days after it was last used, and what you sent after 90 days.
page.done: Done: the account and everything sent from it are deleted.
